commentary.text: 90+10' The match has just finished.
90+8' The free kick from long range, taken by Manchester City, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+8' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cristhian Mosquera (Arsenal) comes onto the pitch for Martin Zubimendi.
90+7' William Saliba (Arsenal) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul. Manchester City have a free kick.
90+7' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+6' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.

90+5' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul. Manchester City are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
90+3' 1 - 1 Goal! Eberechi Eze finds Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) on the edge of the area, he times his run to perfection and beautifully chips the ball over the goalkeeper. 1:1.
90+2' Declan Rice (Arsenal) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' The flag goes up and the referee blows his whistle - another offside by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal), who has already been caught several times today.

87' Pep Guardiola has decided to substitute Jeremy Doku and he is replaced by Savinho (Manchester City).
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and John Stones (Manchester City) is coming onto the pitch as Nico O'Reilly cannot continue after picking up an injury.
86' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle after Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
85' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
85' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
84' The referee allows time for a substitution. Leandro Trossard will be replaced by Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal).
83' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

82' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball zooms around the right post.
81' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post.
81' The current number of corner kicks is 10:1.
81' Gianluigi Donnarumma leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Declan Rice (Arsenal).
80' Mikel Arteta decides to make a substitution. Jurrien Timber will be replaced by Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal).
77' This is an obvious ploy to delay the restart of play from Gianluigi Donnarumma (Manchester City). The referee is firm and issues Gianluigi Donnarumma (Manchester City) a deserved yellow card.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nico (Manchester City) replaces Erling Haaland.
76' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
74' The corner from Declan Rice (Arsenal) is intercepted by Gianluigi Donnarumma.

74' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away. Arsenal force their opponents to concede a corner.
72' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) commits a rough challenge and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for an infringement.
71' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.

68' It's time for a substitution. Nathan Ake (Manchester City) comes on in place of Phil Foden.
67' Pep Guardiola isn't happy on the touchline after referee Stuart Attwell shows him a yellow card.
66' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
64' Declan Rice (Arsenal) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
63' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) is penalised for holding. Stuart Attwell signals a set piece. A free kick has been awarded to Arsenal.
62' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 9:4. The current number of shots on goal is 2:3.
61' Declan Rice (Arsenal) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
61' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag and Arsenal will take a corner.
60' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
60' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
59' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Arsenal will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
58' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
58' Phil Foden (Manchester City) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

57' David Raya pulls off a great save to deny Erling Haaland (Manchester City), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Manchester City.
56' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
56' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick.
54' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
53' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
52' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
50' Eberechi Eze (Arsenal) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot goalwards, but Gianluigi Donnarumma gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
48' Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
46' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
46' Half-time substitution. Pep Guardiola decided to make a change. Abdukodir Khusanov (Manchester City) is replaced by Matheus Nunes.
46' Mikel Arteta has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Bukayo Saka comes on the pitch for Noni Madueke (Arsenal).
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Mikel Arteta probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Mikel Merino (Arsenal). He is replaced by Eberechi Eze.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+5' Noni Madueke almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Mikel Merino (Arsenal) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
45+1' The corner from Noni Madueke (Arsenal) is hurriedly cleared.

45+1' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Noni Madueke (Arsenal) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Gianluigi Donnarumma pulls off a brilliant save. Arsenal earn a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

44' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Gianluigi Donnarumma intercepts the ball. Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
43' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) is adjudged offside.
43' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
41' William Saliba (Arsenal) is furious with himself. He is quickest to the rebound near the penalty spot, but his header goes well wide of the right post!
41' Declan Rice (Arsenal) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
41' Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
39' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul after Gabriel (Arsenal) hacks down one of his opponents.
38' Jeremy Doku passes to Rodri (Manchester City), but he produces a wild shot from the edge of the box which goes high over the bar.
36' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
34' The Arsenal players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
32' Declan Rice floats in a cross for Noni Madueke (Arsenal), whose header from near the penalty spot is really poor and goes well wide of the left post.
31' Total attempts – 0:2. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 0:2.
30' The foul by Erling Haaland (Manchester City) was seen by Stuart Attwell who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
28' Declan Rice (Arsenal) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
27' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
27' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
26' Declan Rice (Arsenal) swings in a cross from the corner, but Gianluigi Donnarumma reads it well and gathers the ball.
26' An attempted cross from Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) is cleared. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Arsenal.
23' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Stuart Attwell no option but to blow his whistle.
22' The linesman raises his flag. Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) is adjudged offside.

22' A through ball from Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) fails to reach Leandro Trossard as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Leandro Trossard could have got into a promising position.
20' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

20' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous low effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by David Raya, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.

20' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
18' The resulting corner from Noni Madueke (Arsenal) comes to nothing.
18' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Arsenal win a corner kick.
17' Abdukodir Khusanov (Manchester City) is able to continue to play.
17' The ball possession is 59:41.
14' The game is interrupted now, Abdukodir Khusanov (Manchester City) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
13' Manchester City seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
9' 0 - 1 GOAL! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) runs onto a pass from Tijjani Reijnders after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from close range. It’s now 0:1.
8' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) plays a terrific long ball forward to Noni Madueke, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
6' Arsenal are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
4' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
2' Riccardo Calafiori loses the ball after receiving a sweet pass from Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal).
1' The first half has started.
